rules.evaluator_infrastructure_failure: EvalPlus harness/platform/import/result-locate failure; not counted as candidate failure
rules.execution_regression: raw EvalPlus pass AND post_h1_h2_h3_h4 EvalPlus fail
rules.invalid_or_missing_candidate: candidate missing, SHA mismatch, or stage source unavailable
rules.partial_repair: raw fail AND final fail AND repair_depth indicates improvement without full EvalPlus pass
rules.transformed_known_pass_preserved: raw pass AND final pass AND decision=transformed
rules.unchanged_failure: decision=abstained/no_source_change AND raw fail AND final fail
rules.unchanged_pass: decision=abstained/no_source_change AND raw pass AND final pass
rules.verified_rescue: raw EvalPlus fail AND post_h1_h2_h3_h4 EvalPlus full pass; parse_rescue/partial_repair/execution_rescue alone never qualify
